responsibility: Machine description fragment for the 256-bit LASX vector extension. It defines LASX-specific unspec codes, mode iterators and attributes for 256-bit integer and floating vector types, and the instruction patterns, expanders, reductions, widening operations, shuffles, saturating/rounding shifts, comparisons, and other RTL mappings needed to select and emit LASX instructions when ISA_HAS_LASX is enabled.
